children: OS Therapies received an approximately $900,000 VAT refund to support OST-HER2 development and readiness activities.
OS Therapies UK received a £678,715.46 refund from HMRC for VAT paid on qualifying expenditures.
The company intends to use the proceeds for Herlystic clinical development and regulatory and commercial-readiness activities.
The FDA suspended its Commissioner’s National Priority Voucher program, but the action does not affect OST-HER2’s rare pediatric disease PRV eligibility.
